title: Set up Claude for Finance — your first 60 minutes
blurb: A weekend setup ritual: install, configure, build context files, set profile preferences, projects, writing style and memory.
body:
"Block the time. Do it this weekend." A 60-minute setup for finance work:

  1. 0–10 · Install Claude — get the desktop app (unlocks Cowork, Code, Skills + access across your local files); Pro is too limited for real finance work.
  2. 10–15 · Model & settings — Opus 4.6 for deep analysis, Sonnet 4.6 for quick formatting/summaries; enable Code Execution & File Creation, Skills, Web Search, Memory.
  3. 15–30 · Context files — the step most skip, and the one that matters most. Create a Claude-Finance folder with markdown files: about you, your rules, your templates.
  4. 30–40 · Profile preferences — your universal instruction set, written in second person ("You are a senior finance professional… include source citations & reconciliation checks…").
  5. 40–50 · First Project — e.g. "Monthly Board Reporting": name it, upload relevant docs (financials, board-deck template, SOPs), write custom instructions.
  6. 50–60 · Writing Style — create a custom style so Claude sounds like you, not like AI.
  7. 60+ · Memory — turn it on; Claude builds a synthesis of what it knows about you, updated regularly. You can add memories manually and import from ChatGPT.
SOURCE · Alyona Mysko (Founder, FuelFinance), "How to set up Claude for finance."
